brief.topic: Questions to ask before connecting an LLM to internal data
brief.audience: PMs and IT leads rolling out internal AI assistants

coreInsight: Don't connect an LLM to internal data until retrieval enforces each user's existing permissions and you've decided what gets logged and kept.

caption.opening: Connecting an assistant to internal documents is a permissions project before it’s an AI project.
body:
Ask, in this order:
→ Who can see each document today?
→ Is that enforced at retrieval time, for each user?
→ What gets logged: prompts, answers, sources?
→ How long is it kept, and who can read the logs?
Red flags: “we index everything once”, “the bot has admin access”, “the vendor keeps the logs”. If retrieval ignores user permissions, don’t connect it yet.

claims.text: Internal AI assistants should enforce each user's existing document permissions at retrieval time, and logging and retention should be decided before connecting internal data.
